proposal.reason: Primary change is the CI test pipeline: daily/source-sanity workflows now generate case inputs from JSON families at prepare time, expand resource/group scheduling (including cross-rack and 8-node handling), and add a new performance-report artifact path with reconciliation-aware parsing and validation. Large CSV deletions/renames and new xtest tooling/tests are supporting this CI execution/reporting redesign rather than changing PCCL runtime modules.
